author: Copilot
description: Hierarchical narrative taxonomy for the Selesnya Conclave. Maps thematic pillars, archetypes, story beats, and card tags to the selesnya_structural_matrix dataset.

community.label: Community
community.description: The Selesnya Conclave prizes collective action above individual glory. Every voice joins the chorus; every hand strengthens the grove.

unity.label: Unity in Action
unity.description: Creatures working in concert — tapping together, triggering on allies entering, or sharing keyword abilities.

shared_purpose.label: Shared Purpose
shared_purpose.description: Mechanics that reward having many creatures or creature types on the battlefield simultaneously.

convocation.label: Convocation
convocation.description: Drawing upon the tapped power of allies to achieve a common goal — analogous to the convoke mechanic.

growth.label: Growth
growth.description: Life expands naturally outward — creatures grow with counters, tokens multiply, and resources accumulate over time.

proliferation.label: Proliferation of Life
proliferation.description: Mechanics that add +1/+1 counters, produce tokens repeatedly, or scale with the number of permanents in play.

resource_expansion.label: Resource Expansion
resource_expansion.description: Ramp effects, mana rocks, and card draw that accelerate the natural engine of the Conclave.

token_multiplication.label: Token Multiplication
token_multiplication.description: Generating creature tokens from spells, abilities, or triggers — the fungal spreading of the grove.

harmony.label: Harmony
harmony.description: White's order and Green's wildness resolve into a balanced whole — neither dominates. Harmony manifests as synergistic interactions and dual-color mechanics.

dual_colour_synergy.label: Dual-Colour Synergy
dual_colour_synergy.description: Effects requiring both green and white mana, rewarding colour commitment.

life_as_resource.label: Life as Resource
life_as_resource.description: Lifegain that triggers secondary effects, converting vitality into board advantage.

protection_and_resilience.label: Protection and Resilience
protection_and_resilience.description: Instants and enchantments that safeguard the board state, echoing White's protective instinct filtered through Green's endurance.

stewardship.label: Stewardship
stewardship.description: The Conclave tends the land, the sacred grove, and the creatures under its care. Stewardship appears as artifact utility, land interaction, and creature care.

land_tending.label: Land Tending
land_tending.description: Abilities tied to the grove itself — land-based token generation, sacrifice outlets, and mana diversification.

artifact_care.label: Artifact Care
artifact_care.description: Artifacts that serve the community — mana sources that can be spent for the greater good.

creature_welfare.label: Creature Welfare
creature_welfare.description: Abilities that keep creatures healthy — indestructible grants, stat buffs, and lifelink bestowals.

Leader.label: Leader
Leader.description: Legendary or rare commanders who direct the Conclave's strategy. They grant wide-reaching buffs, generate multiple tokens on entry, or possess unique activated abilities that shape the board.

Steward.label: Steward
Steward.description: Mid-range permanents that sustain the engine — ramp artifacts, mana sources, and enchantments that produce value over multiple turns.

Vanguard.label: Vanguard
Vanguard.description: Aggressive or efficient creatures that represent the Conclave's martial front — high-power bodies, tramplers, and combat-focused keyword bearers.

Chorus.label: Chorus
Chorus.description: The rank-and-file — common and uncommon creatures and instants that individually seem small but synergise explosively in multiples. The heartbeat of any Selesnya board.

story_beats.title: The Grove Stirs
story_beats.description: Opening phase. The grove awakens — early mana and low-cost creatures establish board presence. Sets the foundation for the Conclave's engine.

story_beats.title: Roots Run Deep
story_beats.description: Mid-game consolidation. Enchantments and key creatures lock in ongoing value generation. Populate begins.

story_beats.title: The Chorus Rises
story_beats.description: Token flood peaks. The board swells with creature tokens. Anthem effects transform the swarm into a lethal force.

story_beats.title: The Vanguard Marches
story_beats.description: Finisher phase. Large threats and combat keywords close out the game. Tramplers punch through token blockers.

story_beats.title: Nature's Verdict
story_beats.description: Reactive phase. Instants answer threats, exile problem permanents, and protect the board on the opponent's turn.

story_beats.title: The Leader Speaks
story_beats.description: Legendary or planeswalker resolution. A singular powerful permanent reshapes the game and inspires the Chorus.

tag_definitions.populate: Mechanic that creates a copy of a creature token you control.
tag_definitions.anthem: Effect that grants +N/+N (or similar stat boost) to all or most creatures you control.
tag_definitions.token: Creates one or more creature tokens, or relates primarily to creature tokens.
tag_definitions.lifegain: Causes the controller to gain life points.
tag_definitions.buff: Grants a permanent or temporary stat increase (+1/+1 counters, keyword abilities) to one or more creatures.
tag_definitions.removal: Destroys, exiles, bounces, or otherwise removes an opponent's permanent.
tag_definitions.ramp: Provides additional mana resources (land fetching, mana rocks, cost reduction).
tag_definitions.creature: Permanent type — creature card or token-producing creature.
tag_definitions.instant: Spell type — instant or sorcery (used for both in this taxonomy for filtering convenience).
